payload.recallText: There were two families. One was the family of the protagonist and the other family was the Kennedys. They had a lot of similarities with the Kennedy's. It cuts to a family trip where they are on the beach. Their family (primarily the aunts) pull up chairs to spy on the Kennedy's. While that is happening, the kids get caught up on a boat and get swept from shore. The Kennedy boys end up saving them. They get punished and can only stay on the beach or get in the water up to their knees. They start playing chicken fight and the protagnoist ends up kicking him and knocking his eye out.
